retrieval.network_use: Public upstream Git history and snapshot blobs only. The fetch was limited to ancestry after 2022-08-01 ending at the exact I commit, used blob filtering, fetched no tags, did not invoke Git LFS, and performed no model or dependency retrieval.

snapshot_digest.canonical_stream: For every regular file or symbolic link beneath the snapshot, sort relative paths by raw byte value under LC_ALL=C. Emit one UTF-8 line per entry as '<git-mode> <decimal-payload-byte-count> <lowercase-payload-sha256>\t<relative-path>\n'. For regular files the payload is the exact file bytes and git-mode is 100755 when executable and 100644 otherwise. For symbolic links the payload is the link-target bytes and git-mode is 120000. Hash the concatenated lines. Git contains no empty directories.
snapshot_digest.independent_identity_check: Every path and mode from git ls-tree -r -z <revision> was checked against the extracted entry. Git hash-object of each regular file, or of each symbolic-link target payload, equalled the recorded Git blob object. No .git directory or .gitmodules file is present in any snapshot.
snapshot_digest.git_archive_tar_digest_note: The additional archive digest is SHA-256 of the uncompressed byte stream produced by git 2.34.1 using 'git archive --format=tar <revision>'.

source.subject: Allow passing non-default modules to pipeline (#188)

frozen_property_check.focal_assumption: When DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained is invoked on the base DiffusionPipeline class, the pipeline_class it instantiates can originate only from code already installed in the diffusers package; a model- or caller-selected external repository cannot supply that executable class.
frozen_property_check.source: The base-class branch imports the installed diffusers package and resolves config_dict['_class_name'] on that package. The only other branch is an explicitly invoked subclass. Caller-supplied kwargs replace already-instantiated components, not pipeline_class. The selected pipeline_class is instantiated as model.
frozen_property_check.compatible: The same exhaustive class-selection and instantiation structure remains after smart downloading. No custom_pipeline argument or external dynamic-class call appears in DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained.
frozen_property_check.invalidated: The loader accepts caller-selected custom_pipeline values naming a Hub repository, community source, or local directory, invokes get_class_from_dynamic_module before the installed-package branches, and instantiates the returned pipeline_class. Upstream tests affirmatively load a CustomPipeline that is not defined in the installed library and exists solely in a Hub repository.
frozen_property_check.conclusion: Executable inspection does not contradict the frozen p*(S)=TRUE, p*(C)=TRUE, p*(I)=FALSE conclusions.

runtime_assessment.project_runtime: Historical Python package. setup.py declares Python >=3.6.0 at S and >=3.7.0 at C and I. Package versions are 0.1.3 at S and 0.4.0.dev0 at C and I.
